name: PMDT
description: "DVD transport with a modular structure.A slot-in card type module structure is adopted in the rear panel. By adding an expansion module, it can cope with various audio output and video output formats. In addition to the modularization of the communication board, the built-in control software can be expanded or upgraded by incorporating the computer communication function.This allows for the playback of dts, 96kHz/24bit high-bit high-sampling software, and DVD audio.The transport mechanism adopts the latest design mechanism, and the combination of the original design aluminum die-cast high-precision mechanical bench and tray realizes accurate and stable reading.In the image signal processing section, we have introduced technologies at the level of professional video equipment such as an oversampling video D/A converter and a dual-clock system with high clock accuracy.Separate power supply units are installed for the drive and servo units of the transport with different operation modes. Separate power supply units are also installed for the video signal system and audio signal system. In addition, the local regulation system is adopted for each circuit to eliminate mutual interference caused by power supply.When playing DVD software, it has a built-in custom memory function that stores the settings made by the user on the menu screen in the console for each software. This enables you to set the audio, subtitle, screen size, etc. once and then enjoy the same settings at any time by simply pressing the play button.With this function, it is possible to store the setting information of up to 2,000 discs even if you make full settings such as selecting playback chapters of up to 99 tracks.Wireless remote control is included."

name: CDLIBRARY
description: "A CD library that can store, organize, search, and play back 100 pieces of CD software.As the name of the library indicates, 100 pieces of CD software can be sorted into three basic categories : software title, artist name, and music genre. The stored CD software can be played back freely via a dedicated communicator, which is equivalent to a remote control.It is equipped with a custom LSI computer part including a ROM storing software information.The title name, artist name and music genre of each CD software to be stored are input into the memory of the CD library by communicator and keyboard. In addition to the usual categories such as orchestra, piano, jazz and pop music, the music genre can be registered with the original name of the music you want to pick up according to the purpose.You can enter 15 types of music genre per song.It avoids the degradation of resolution caused by jitter distortion, and uses a high-precision 8 x oversampling digital filter that is selected with the highest priority on sound quality and an 18-bit D/A converter of the highest quality.In the mechanism section, Philips' CDM1MkII, which has excellent vibration resistance and reliability, is mounted on the transport.The output jacks are equipped with two unbalanced / balanced analog outputs (fixed and variable) and one balanced / unbalanced digital output."

name: PCD
description: "CD player for better sound quality and higher reliability.The internal circuit board consists of the transport section, power supply section, decoder section, D/A converter to analog output section, and display control section. These circuit boards are placed with sufficient space between them to eliminate interference between elements and circuits that can cause sound quality degradation. They are also placed adjacent to each other at an angle of 90 degrees.Since these boards are plug-in type, it is possible to upgrade by exchanging each circuit board.The internal structure of the PCD is a rigid frame structure using aluminum pull-out material with a transport mechanism at the center. This is based on the same principle as that used in building construction. It does not generate resonance for both high-frequency and low-frequency vibrations, and works effectively for vibration control.The cabinet interior of the PCD, including the frame structure, is coated with conductive paint and anti-rust treatment to prevent accumulation of static electricity.The transport mechanism is Philips' CDM1MKII.It is equipped with an 18-bit monolithic D/A converter from Bar Brown for the highest quality audio. In addition, to minimize noise and distortion, each DAC is fully tested for power supply, and the MSB is carefully adjusted as installed prior to shipment.The digital filter uses a high-precision type with 8 times oversampling.Oversampling to avoid quantization noise may lead to resolution degradation due to jitter distortion if the oversampling is too high, so PCD selects 8 x oversampling to maximize the sound quality advantage of the technology at that time.Each circuit of the PCD, including the D/A converter circuit, is a hybrid system with selected elements to achieve the best performance, and the PCD uses a continuous power supply system to maximize the performance of the parts.The main power switch is located on the back panel of the unit and normally uses the standby power switch on the front panel to ensure stable operation of each part.The power supply section is equipped with a power supply circuit equivalent to a high-precision measuring instrument, incorporating Mark Levinson's expertise in preamp design. To prevent interference between circuits via power supply lines, a total of 13 power supplies are supplied, and 12 of them are regulated independently. For example, in the audio output circuit alone, a total of four regulation circuits are provided to supply power independently to the plus and minus channels of the left and right channels.We have also made unique efforts to reduce the impedance of the grounding circuit and to set the optimum grounding point.One unbalanced and one balanced analog output terminal and one coaxial digital output terminal are installed.It comes with a wireless remote control that allows you to operations except power ON/OFF and disk tray IN/OUT."

name: PDP
description: "Based on the D/A converter circuit and analog audio circuit developed for PCD, a D/A converter was developed by adding a unique interface circuit.In a PDP, the interface circuit at the input stage improves the digital signal.In this circuit, the input signal passes through a top-of-the-line pulse transformer for computers and is fed into a proprietary DAS receiver circuit, which removes any distortion from the transmission path and adjusts the waveform to a shape close to the original signal before sending it to the D/A converter stage.The analog circuits incorporate as much as possible the results of Mark Levinson's amplifier development.In addition, the power supply circuit for PCD is adopted as it is, and PDP with less load compared with PCD realizes a sufficient power supply.There are four types of digital input jacks, a coaxial Route 3 and a balanced one, which can be selected with the select switch on the front panel. The selected digital signal automatically determines the sampling frequency and displays the corresponding frequency from among 32, 44, and 48.In addition to one unbalanced and one balanced output terminal, a coaxial digital output terminal is also installed.This digital output does not directly output the input digital signal, but is output after the waveform is adjusted by the DAS receiver in the interface circuit of the input stage."
